_about: Curated editorial copy for scripts/gen-work.mjs. The registry (REGISTRY.json) is the source of truth for WHICH projects are live; this file is the voice — one line, what it shows off, and the order. Anything in the registry with showcase:true + a live link appears even without notes here (it gets a generated description). Adding a note is what turns an entry into a proper card. `extras` are projects the registry does not own (this site, the Gallery).

tidework-studio.title: Tidework
tidework-studio.desc: A boutique audio studio's site, where the logo is actually a live oscilloscope you can drag.

ember-run.title: Ember Run
ember-run.desc: Dusk over a dune sea: thread the ember ribbons, dodge the spires, land it in 60 seconds.

vesper.title: Vesper
vesper.desc: A lamp, lit and finished live in the browser. Crisp edges and a loader whose percentage is real bytes.

tomo-01.title: Tomo-01
tomo-01.desc: A fictional handheld, as a paper catalogue. The device opens on scroll; both screens are live canvases.

handheld-oneshot-test.title: TOCK & friends
handheld-oneshot-test.desc: The same brief handed to a model four ways. One page each, shipped without a human editing the words.

afterlight.title: Afterlight
afterlight.desc: Fly a courier through a floating karst archipelago at dusk, through lit stone rings, to the beacon.

itlala.title: Itlala — إطلالة
itlala.desc: A Saudi styling assistant that starts from the occasion, not the grid: pieces, stores, a price sheet.
shows: brief -> phone result in one pass

nd96.title: ND96 · Asir
nd96.desc: A projector race that 45 phones steer at once, art-directed as an Asiri mountain town.

kayak-game.title: Wadi Paddle
kayak-game.desc: The same 45-phone rig, upstream: a night kayak race through a wadi, won on the water.

hermes-gallery.title: Hermes Gallery
hermes-gallery.desc: Every project that ships gets a thumbnail and a card here, on an hourly rebuild, without anyone filing paperwork.

hermes-studio.title: Hermes Studio
hermes-studio.desc: The site you are reading. Its work list is generated from the registry at build time, so it cannot go stale.
